recovery.confirmHelp: I have reviewed this pipeline, its source full-load capability, models, and target handling, and explicitly confirm a new full rebuild. A changed scope needs a new preview.
recovery.clusterConfirmHelp: I have stopped and isolated every old cluster member using the deployment tools and verified that old source/target connections and in-flight writes have ended. I confirm this entire scope. The cluster checks local cleanup and storage identity; I am responsible for isolation across machines. All affected pipelines will remain stopped.
recovery.clusterComplete: Runtime storage is ready. Every affected pipeline remains stopped until you explicitly confirm its full rebuild. This does not mean its data or targets have recovered.
recovery.targets: Target handling for this full rebuild
recovery.executionFailed: This operation has not completed. Inspect the pipeline error. If its run failed, stop it before explicitly continuing this original operation.
recovery.stalePreview: The current inputs no longer match this preview. Check the original scope and preview it again before confirming.

policy.APPEND: Keep existing rows and apply the configured write mode.
policy.CLEAR: Clear the selected target tables before loading the full source again.
policy.FAIL: Refuse the full load if a selected target table already contains rows.

recovery.sharedHelp: Use both original identities from the storage diagnosis. The server determines the actual affected pipelines. Other shared logs and their readers continue to run.
recovery.sharedConfirmHelp: I have stopped and isolated the listed pipelines and the old shared capture on every machine, and verified that their old source/target connections and in-flight writes have ended. I confirm this exact scope. The affected pipelines will remain stopped and each needs an explicit full rebuild.
recovery.sharedComplete: The replacement shared log is ready. For each listed pipeline, use Stop with clear state, then explicitly start its full load. Other pipelines keep their state. The affected data and targets have not yet recovered.
recovery.sharedFailure: This original shared recovery has not completed. Inspect its error and recheck this same scope before confirming a changed preview.

transfer.title: Transfer configuration
transfer.help: Export selected resources and their required definitions in an encrypted package. Runtime state, business data and cluster keys are excluded. Keep the transfer key separately; it is never stored here.
transfer.confirmHelp: I confirm this default-target mapping and insertion of the checked configuration. Existing resources are not overwritten and pipelines will not start automatically.

phaseHelp.NOT_CONFIGURED: Test and save the databases before using the cluster.
phaseHelp.PREPARING: The original setup is being prepared. Saved database settings stay in place.
phaseHelp.RESTART_REQUIRED: Storage is saved. Restart through the installation command, then authorize first-administrator creation.
phaseHelp.FIRST_ADMIN_REQUIRED: Set a username and password for the first administrator.
phaseHelp.AUTH_READY: Authentication is available. Business services are still waiting for storage admission.
phaseHelp.READY: Runtime storage is admitted. Each layer below reports its own verification state.
phaseHelp.UNAVAILABLE: Restore the original storage and check again. Do not replace the binding or repeat installation.
phaseHelp.AWAITING_REBUILD_CONFIRMATION: Sign-in has been restored; business state has not. Review and explicitly confirm the rebuild.
phaseHelp.RECOVERING: Check the original recovery operation. Business access remains closed until recovery is verified.
phaseHelp.CLEANUP_REQUIRED: A previous attempt has not confirmed resource cleanup. Keep the original settings and check again.

storage.title: Cluster storage

verification.help: Refresh status checks the current default destination. Results expire after 10 minutes.

storage.entryUnavailable: Cluster sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Your saved storage settings are retained.
storage.autoRefresh: Status updates automatically. You do not need to refresh or submit again.
storage.autoRetry: The status check could not complete. Retrying automatically; your original request has not been resubmitted.
storage.setupSubmittingHelp: Saving your database settings and preparing the cluster.
storage.setupSavedHelp: The database settings are saved. The cluster is preparing its runtime.
storage.resumeSetupHelp: These databases are already bound. Use the original connection details to continue. If the previous result is uncertain, refresh its status first.

alerts.unavailable: Unable to load current alert data. Try again.
alerts.isolated: Some records use unsupported formats and are isolated. Detection coverage may be incomplete.
alerts.coverageNote: Health describes connected detectors only. No alerts does not prove complete health.
alerts.automatic: Alerts recover automatically when fresh evidence confirms recovery. Viewing does not change their state.
alerts.truncated: Stack was truncated to the capture budget.
alerts.unknownObservation: Observation is interrupted. The last confirmed fault remains; recovery is not known.
alerts.cloudAccepted: Cloud accepted the event. Notification evaluation and delivery are separate.
alerts.placeholder: Historical local placeholder; no remote receipt
alerts.acceptanceBoundary: Provider acceptance does not mean the recipient has received or read the message.
alerts.retryRisk: The original result may be unknown. Another attempt can duplicate a message. The original target, content and deadline remain.
alerts.refused: The operation was refused. Check current permissions, input and concurrency, then reload before retrying.
alerts.cleanupPending: Cleanup health is unavailable until maintenance integration is connected.
alerts.stoppedProcess: A fully stopped process cannot immediately report its own outage.
alerts.cloudSettings: Cloud-managed Clusters use Cloud event policies for external notifications. Email/Webhook settings, tests, templates and retry controls are unavailable here.
alerts.routesNote: Routes control extra notifications. They do not disable detection or hide alerts.
alerts.configurationNote: Changes take effect only after saving. Detection and notification controls are separate.
alerts.name: Name
alerts.allResources: All current resources of the selected type
alerts.resourceIdentity: Use the current resource identity. Recreated resources require a new selection.
alerts.inhibitionNote: Only currently proven resource dependencies suppress notifications. Alerts remain visible.
alerts.exampleOnly: Example only. Preview sends nothing and changes no alert state.
alerts.testFixed: Send the fixed test message using the current form. Testing does not save or create a real alarm.
alerts.testSuccessUnsaved: Test accepted, not saved. Save and activate to use this configuration.
alerts.testSuccessSaved: Test accepted for this saved candidate.
alerts.testUnknown: Test result is unknown. Check the receiver before explicitly starting a new test. It will not retry automatically.
alerts.testFailed: Test was not accepted. Saved configuration was not changed.
alerts.testQueued: Test task created; waiting for provider acceptance.
alerts.testQueryFailed: Unable to query this test. Do not infer a failed send or resend automatically.
alerts.silenceNote: Silence pauses notifications while detection and alert history continue.
alerts.unsavedNote: Testing does not save changes. Choose how to leave this form.
alerts.saved: Saved. Future notifications use the new configuration.
alerts.singleTestTarget: Choose one current recipient for this test.
alerts.endpointPrivate: The full URL is private and is never returned. Keep original private material to test the saved endpoint, or re-enter it to replace it.
alerts.replacePrivateNote: To replace private material, provide all required fields together. Existing values never appear in this form.

alerts.selectAlert: Select an alert to view its evidence
alerts.healthScope: Connected health checks: observation, detection, storage, delivery and maintenance
alerts.evaluationNote: Connected evaluators continue checking fresh evidence. Missing providers remain unavailable.
alerts.storageHealthNote: Inspect the authoritative storage panel. This screen does not infer write health from a successful read.

alerts.inhibitionRoutesNote: Inhibition is attached to a route and requires a currently proven resource dependency. It does not recover or hide an alert.

alerts.managedRoutesNote: Alerts remain visible in the shared alert center. External notifications depend on the managed SDK channel and organization policy; direct receiver and route configuration is unavailable here.

alerts.syntheticRuleNote: Virtual-clock lifecycle example over synthetic conclusions. This does not verify the real producer, save configuration, publish an alert or send a notification.

alerts.inhibitionLifecycle: While the root cause remains active, pause notifications for the related resources. Their alerts remain evaluated and visible. After recovery, notifications follow the dependent resource’s current state.
alerts.disabledInhibitionNote: Only enabled relations are stored. Disabling removes them from the route; the current draft is kept here until you leave.
